text:
oncall-alex: paging — seeing sustained TPM spike for rocquet13b in us-west from 03:04 -> 03:09, tail latency creeping up. opening a mitigation thread.
incident-bot: ALERT: model-rocquet13b tpm: 4.1k (baseline 900), p95 latency 420ms (+180ms). triggered model-quota-guard.
runtime-lee: noticed a lot of small-chat requests with long context. suspect some tenants are abusing streaming + funcalls.
sre-jamie: can we gate per-tenant first, otherwise we'll blow CPU and cause cross-model impact.
oncall-alex: plan: 1) apply temporary per-model TPM cap 750 2) disable function-calls for rocquet13b 3) carve tenant quotas for top offenders. executing now.
runtime-lee: commands I will run:
```
# set per-model cap
POST /admin/v1/models/rocquet13b/quota
{"tpm":750, "rpm":20, "reason":"emergency latency mitigation"}
# disable funcall
POST /admin/v1/models/rocquet13b/features
{"funcall_enabled":false}
```
infra-ops: I'm on the API toggle. will log actions to audit. applying model cap (propagates in ~10s across us-west hosts).
customer-ops: ping — do we have list of affected customers for notification? product-maya wants to craft a customer note.
sre-jamie: top offending tenants by tpm in last 5m: tenant-q, tenant-z, tenant-b. suggest carving: tenant-q 120 tpm, tenant-z 60, tenant-b 40, remaining pool shared.
oncall-alex: carving config snippet (applied):
```
quoterules:
  tenant-q: 120
  tenant-z: 60
  tenant-b: 40
fallback: shared_pool
```
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: model cap set to 750, funcall disabled, tenant carve rules applied. ticket INC-2026-489 created, paging engagement notified.
runtime-lee: monitoring streaming connection counts. if p95 > 500ms after 2m we escalate to capacity-add.
infra-ops: cap and funcall toggle confirmed in prod (us-west). latency trending down to p95 230ms.
product-maya: thanks — I'll draft a short status and notify customers on the affected list. include that funcall disabled temporarily and will be restored after postmortem.
customer-ops: noted. reaching out to tenant-q and tenant-z now with ETA ~30m for review call if needed.
sre-jamie: next steps: keep carve for 30m, then slowly raise model tpm in 50% increments while watching p95 and error rate. if any downstream error spike, revert immediately.
oncall-alex: acknowledging. will leave this thread open; update here when we remove toggle or if we need follow-up incident review."
